title: Instant Store Credit at First Scan
content:
On a Returns & Exchanges Store Credit Return — the only return type that pays Return Store Credit at the first carrier scan — Marlowe & Finch pays the customer before the parcel is inspected and squares the difference at settlement.

## Clauses

1. **Instant credit.** Where the return type pays Return Store Credit at the first carrier scan, a Return Store Credit for the full value credited-to-be of the authorized units, before fees, is issued on the date of the first carrier scan.
2. **Reconciliation.** At settlement the difference between that instant credit and what is actually owed after inspection and fees is reconciled. A positive difference is paid as further Return Store Credit on the same instrument at final settlement.
3. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause providing that a negative difference is recovered from the Return Store Credit instrument up to its current balance and that any shortfall already spent is charged to the original card has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
4. **Timing of a reversal.** An instant credit is reversed only once the return is in status inspected.

## Reconciliation at a glance

| Owed after inspection and fees, compared with the instant credit | Treatment |
|---|---|
| More than the instant credit | The difference is paid as further Return Store Credit on the same instrument at final settlement |
| Equal | Nothing further to pay |

| Return status | Instant credit may be reversed |
|---|---|
| Inspected | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

Example (hypothetical): the instant credit at the first scan was 120.00 USD; after inspection and fees the return is owed 130.00 USD, so 10.00 USD of further Return Store Credit is paid on the same instrument at final settlement.

superseded_clauses: a negative difference is recovered from the Return Store Credit instrument up to its current balance, and any shortfall already spent is charged to the original card (`instant_credit_shortfall_recovery`)
